QuestInfo.name: Your Third Informant Assignment
QuestInfo.0: You are now Lv. 20. #p1002104# will probably give you that new assignment. Go to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002104# suspects that the #o1140100# case in #m102000000# is similar to the Puppeteer case in #m100000000# and asks you to gather some information about it. To get the details, head over to #b#m102000000##k and talk to #b#p1103004##k...

0.0: How's your training going, hero? There's another informant assignment I'd like for you to take. The #b#o1140130# population in #m102000000# again#k... Sound familiar? I bet our friend the Puppeteer is back at #m102000000#.
0.1: Ask #b#p1103004##k at #m102000000# for details. She's investigating the excavation site and should know more about it.
0.2: I imagine you have a pretty good sense of Victoria Island by now. You know where #m102000000# is, right? The warrior village at the northern tip of Victoria Island? There's a girl there you need to go find. Don't be put off by her name. She's definitely a girl. Now, off you go!\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Hmmm... We're not gathering information this time just to make money, but to investigate and battle the Black Wings that are following the Black Mage.Think about it again.

1.0: Ah, are you Aran? #p1002104# told me that you'll be helping with the incidents on North Rocky Mountain...

npc.0: You haven't gone to #b#m102000000##k yet? #b#p1103004##k is waiting for you, you know. It looks like it's related to the puppeteer again, so I suggest you go there and conduct a thorough investigation.
